result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you section and a slightly cut-off category chip on the right.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you carousel card.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards and text containers fully display restaurant names without clipping.

issues.description: The rightmost category filter chip appears partially cut off at the screen edge beyond the expected carousel peek.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent end padding to the horizontal category scroller so chips are not abruptly clipped.
